- Extract VAT group lines: VAT rate (remove %), Net amount (Grundlage), VAT amount (Mehrwertsteuerbetrag) preserving decimals.
- Extract Grand Total amount from explicit total or Nettowarenwert/Umsatzsteuer/Final total if present.
- If any required field is missing or ambiguous in the text, leave it empty per No Inference policy.
- Return final values in the specified JSON schema.
